methodologyNotes: Dataset covers 12 high-search baby stroller models spanning full-size, travel system, lightweight, and jogging categories. Specs were re-verified against official manufacturer pages (uppababy.com, bugaboo.com via Strolleria, bobgear.com, thule.com, nunababy.com, chiccousa.com, joolz.com, babyjogger.com, doona.com) and authorized major retailers (Little Folks NYC, Strolleria, Babylist, ANB Baby, Bambi Baby, Kidsland). All boolean fields reflect explicitly stated features; null is used where a spec was not found or was contradicted by competing sources without resolution. Prices are published US prices verified as of accessedAt 2026-06-19. Adversarial re-check applied to priceUsd, releaseDate, and headline specs; one source URL corrected (Cruz V2) and Cruz V2 price updated to the current published authorized-retailer list price.

products.name: UPPAbaby VISTA V2
products.priceNote: Published price (frame + toddler seat), Little Folks NYC authorized retailer; V3 is current flagship but V2 still sold
products.provenance: Re-verified 2026-06-19: price $1,049, weight 27 lb (frame + seat), folded 17.3 x 25.7 x 33.3 in, max child 50 lb all confirmed directly on Little Folks NYC product page. Released April 2020 (alongside Cruz V2). Reversible seat, one-hand fold, car-seat compatible are documented VISTA V2 features. No corrections needed.

products.name: UPPAbaby CRUZ V2
products.priceNote: Current published list price on authorized retailer (Little Folks NYC); original 2020 MSRP was $699.99 but the model has since increased to $899.99 list as the V3 replaces it
products.provenance: Corrected 2026-06-19: original draft source (strolleria.com/pages/uppababy-vista-v2-review) was a VISTA review page, NOT topical to the Cruz V2 — replaced with the Little Folks NYC Cruz V2 product page. Price corrected from $699.99 to $899.99: $699.99 was the original 2020 MSRP, but the current published list price on the authorized retailer is $899.99 (often on sale ~$799.99); the Strolleria Cruz V2 URL now redirects to V3 content. Weight 25.5 lb (frame + seat) and folded 16.5 x 22.8 x 33 in confirmed by Strollberry spec sheet and multiple aggregators (Little Folks lists a 17 x 22.3 x 36 in measurement variation; the widely-cited 16.5 x 22.8 x 33 retained). Max child 50 lb. Released April 2020.

products.name: Nuna MIXX next
products.priceNote: Published price, stroller only; travel system configurations cost more
products.provenance: Re-verified 2026-06-19: weight 28.3 lb (without arm bar/insert), folded 27.5 x 23.6 x 19 in, and max child 50 lb confirmed directly on official Nuna USA product page. Price $900 corroborated via Bambi Baby authorized retailer and widely cited as current price. Red Dot 2020 design winner supports 2020 release. Reversible seat and one-hand compact fold are documented MIXX next features. No corrections needed.

products.name: Bugaboo Fox 5 Renew
products.priceNote: Published price, complete stroller with bassinet and seat (Renew = 2025 refurbished/sustainability re-launch of the Fox 5 platform)
products.provenance: Re-verified 2026-06-19: price $1,499 confirmed on Strolleria Fox 5 Renew product page. The Renew is the 2025 re-launch variant (the original Fox 5 platform launched March 2023; Renew is correctly dated 2025). Weight 21.12 lb (with seat) corroborated by multiple sources; folded 17.3 x 23.6 x 35.4 in is the one-piece self-standing fold (two-piece compact fold ~35 x 20.9 x 13.4 in). Max child 50 lb, reversible seat, one-hand fold, car-seat compatible all documented Fox 5 features. Corroboration URL updated to a live official Bugaboo Fox 5 Renew product page.

products.name: Baby Jogger City Mini GT2
products.provenance: Re-verified 2026-06-19: price $399.99 confirmed on ANB Baby; weight 22.4 lb and max child 65 lb confirmed on official Baby Jogger product page. Folded 24.5 x 31.5 x 10 in confirmed by multiple sources. Seat faces forward only (no parent-facing/reversible mode). Released 2019. No corrections needed.

products.name: Doona Car Seat & Stroller
products.priceNote: Published price for standard edition with LATCH base; Midnight/special editions ~$750
products.provenance: Re-verified 2026-06-19: price $650 (Midnight Edition $750) confirmed on official Doona USA and Strolleria. Max child 35 lb confirmed (rear-facing infant car seat, 4-35 lb) by official Doona and multiple sources. Weight ~16.5 lb standard (official lists 17.2 lb for some color variants). Folded 26 x 17.4 x 22.4 in. Doona car seat first announced 2014; categorized as travel_system (infant car seat that converts to stroller). It is itself the car seat, so car_seat_compatible=true.

products.name: BOB Gear Revolution Flex 3.0
products.priceNote: Current published price on official bobgear.com (launch MSRP was $449.99 in 2019)
products.provenance: Re-verified 2026-06-19: price $649.99, weight 28.5 lb, max child 75 lb, and folded (wheels on) 38 x 25 x 16 in all confirmed directly on official BOB Gear product page. Introduced January 2019. No reversible seat; requires a two-step fold (one_hand_fold=false). Car-seat compatible via adapter. No corrections needed.

products.name: Thule Urban Glide 3
products.provenance: Re-verified 2026-06-19: all specs confirmed directly on the official Thule US product page — price $799.95, weight 26.2 lb, max child 49 lb, folded 34.6 x 22.8 x 12.2 in. One-hand compact fold with self-stand. No reversible seat. Released 2024 (iF Design / Red Dot 2024 award). No corrections needed.

products.name: Graco Modes Pramette
products.priceNote: Published price, stroller only (Pierce colorway); full travel system costs more
products.provenance: Re-verified 2026-06-19: price $249.99, weight 20.86 lb, folded 25.6 x 41.7 x 16.5 in, and max child 50 lb all confirmed on Babylist spec sheet; Target lists $249.99 / 50 lb capacity. Reversible seat and one-hand fold confirmed on Graco and retailer pages. Specific model year not published by Graco (release null). Source promoted to Babylist (carries full spec sheet) with Target as corroboration.

products.name: Chicco Bravo 3-in-1 Trio Travel System
products.priceNote: Published price, full travel system including KeyFit 30 infant car seat and base
products.provenance: Re-verified 2026-06-19: price $449.99 confirmed directly on official Chicco USA product page (retailers/Target list $399.99 sale; official MSRP is $449.99 — draft retained). Stroller weight 24.9 lb (toddler stroller assembled), folded 15 x 22.8 x 36.8 in (tray installed) confirmed on Chicco page. Seat does not reverse; one-hand quick fold. Release ~2020. No corrections needed.

products.name: BABYZEN YOYO2
products.priceNote: Published regular price for complete 6+ stroller (frame + seat cushion + canopy); sale pricing often lower
products.provenance: Re-verified 2026-06-19: regular price $449 for complete 6+ stroller corroborated by multiple authorized retailers (Strolleria, Albee Baby). Weight ~13.5 lb (BABYZEN official cites 13.6 lb for 6+ config), folded ~20.5 x 17.3 x 7.1 in (official lists 20 x 17 x 7 in), max child 48.5 lb per official specs. Seat faces forward only. Car-seat compatible with adapters. Corroboration URL updated to a live official BABYZEN US product page.

products.name: Joolz Hub+
products.priceNote: Published price on joolz.com/us; chassis + seat configuration
products.provenance: Re-verified 2026-06-19: price $729, weight 24.3 lb (chassis + seat), max child 50 lb, and folded 25 x 21 x 12 in all confirmed directly on official Joolz US product page. Reversible seat confirmed (Joolz Hub seat is reversible for face-to-face or outward use). One-hand 'fold and go'. Release ~2020. No corrections needed.
